title: BT-GN-02 – Explosive mixture in the reheat furnace (Hadeed gas network example)
description: Threat T1 = flame failure 4 /yr x P(below auto-ignition temperature) 0.2 with the BMS barrier from fault tree FT-GN-03 gate G-002 – its contribution equals the FT-GN-03 top event and the event tree ETA-GN-02 branch 'below AIT, fuel still flowing'. Mitigative barriers 'draught / post-purge' and 'explosion relief doors' are ETA-GN-02 headings H3 and H4. HAZOP N06; FMECA S06. Illustrative data.
hazard: Natural gas fuel in the reheat furnace firing system (0.3–1.5 barg at the burners)

project.title: FT-GN-03 – Reheat furnace explosive mixture after flame failure (Hadeed gas network example)
project.description: Top event: explosive gas / air mixture in a reheat furnace zone because a burner loses flame (or fails to light) while the zone is below auto-ignition temperature and the BMS flame-failure shut-off fails. Gate G-002 = PFDavg of the BMS shut-off (scanners BS-4010, logic BMS-4000, SSOVs XV-4002A/B 1oo2) – used by event tree ETA-GN-02 heading H2 and bow tie BT-GN-02 threat T1. HAZOP N06-01; FMECA S06. Illustrative failure data – replace with site / vendor data before use. Part of the Hadeed gas network PHA worked example (HAZOP HZ-EX-GN-001).
